system.description:
A senselink port, usually in the spine or wrist, that lets the owner interface directly with machines. Common: +1k0 on Drive, Pilot or Tech-Use Tests with MIU-capable devices.

Poor: works like Common, but using it requires an Intelligence Test (TN 15). Good: +2k0 on those Tests instead, and often links wirelessly. Best adds no further benefit beyond Good.
system.effectText: Common: +1k0 Tech-Use/Pilot/Drive with MIU devices. Poor: needs Int Test TN 15. Good: +2k0, often wireless.
